title: Marhaba ya hussain
body:
karbala mein is tarha ghar tera loota gaya
baap se beta choota hogaya bhai juda
tune har ek gham saha ay saware mustufa
marhaba ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
sabr wo ayub ka qatm hua tha jahan
ibteda-e-sabr thi teri wo shaahe zaman
sabr tera marhaba dilbare mushkil kusha
marhaba ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
deen ki taqdeer ko apne khoon se likh diya
raahe khuda-wand mein kar diya sab kuch fida
ambiya bhi arsh se keh rahe thay marhaba
marhaba ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
thi teri sookhi ragay shimr ke khanjar talay
tune har ek gaam par shukr ke sajde kiye
teri wafadari pe thi ye khuda ki sada
marhaba ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai ke baazu diye seena e akbar diya
nanha sa asghar diya apna bhara ghar diya
deen ka moshin hai tu jaane dil e fathima
marhaba ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
sar diya aur na diya haath mein zaalim ke haat
hurr ke muqadar ko bhi bakshi hai tune hayaat
tera wajaho hashm tera buland martaba
marhaba ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
sar to juda hogaya par na tera sar jhuka
noke sina pe hussain sar tera ooncha raha
sabr ke aagay tere zulm nahi chal saka
marhaba ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
zikr shahe deen ka fatema ke laal ka
ahmed-o-hassan se bhi haq na ada ho saka
aap ke dam se bacha ambiya ka martaba
marhaba ya hussain
author: Zulfiqar Ahmed
